name: slide-parser
body: Slide parser: splits the slide's `---` … `---` YAML frontmatter (must start at line 1), the slide body (after frontmatter, before the first `#` heading), `#` sections, section plain-fence frontmatter, section bodies and the speaker notes (at most one `# notes`, which must be the last section and is excluded from section min/max counts), keeping line numbers.
